subject: Post-call briefing: retail growth asks & escalation lanes
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@ironretail.com>, Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@ironretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call briefing: retail growth asks & escalation lanes

Hi Tom / Hannah — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick write-up so we have a single source of truth and owners for next steps.

High-level business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce checkout latency spikes in peak traffic by 60% to avoid cart abandonment during promotions.
- Cut per-transaction inference cost by ~30% without degrading NPS for recommendations.
- Retain full auditability for personalized recommendations (7-day KV/cache retention + audit logs).

Primary pain points we heard:
- Current endpoint times out under burst (Black Friday style) and lacks graceful fallback.
- Cost volatility from per-request autoscaling and little reuse of cached prefixes.
- Security/compliance: need SOC 2 summary and evidence around data residency for EU shoppers (some traffic crosses regions).

What we recommended on the call (short):
- Dedicated pool for recommendation pipeline with autoscale buffer for promo windows (predictable latency + cost cap).
- Prefix caching + KV cache tuning for session-heavy flows to reduce per-token work.
- Short contract addendum for audit log retention and region routing; we can provide SOC 2 summary and network diagram.

Immediate asks & owners (date targets):
1) SOC 2 summary + network topology (attachment stub) — Olga to share by EOD Thu (2026-08-13).
2) SOW draft with scoped Dedicated capacity and canary rollout plan — Rishi to send internal draft by Fri (2026-08-14).
3) Procurement checklist / PO path and estimated budget range — Tom/Hannah to confirm preferred cadence; Laura to run a pricing sketch once procurement lane is confirmed (target 2026-08-18).
4) Escalation lane if latency breaches SLA during rollout — Marcus will own on-call playbook and fallback policy (target: readiness by 2026-08-20).

Next meeting: propose short internal + procurement sync on Mon 2026-08-16 (30 minutes) to align contract language and PO steps.

Attachments I will drop into the thread: SOC2-summary-IR.pdf (summary), SOW-redwood-draft.docx (skeleton), network-topology-stub.png.

If I missed anything, flag it — otherwise I’ll send the SOC2 doc now and loop Rishi on the SOW draft.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@ironretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@ironretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call briefing: retail growth asks & escalation lanes

Thanks Olga — this is great and captures the call. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Procurement path: we need a vendor security pack plus SOW to start an internal vendor review. The review board meets weekly on Thursdays; earliest PO approval will be Aug 27 if docs are complete.
- Budget: we’re targeting an initial pilot spend of $40k / month for Dedicated capacity on the recommendation flow; could scale after proving latency improvements.
- Data residency: majority of EU traffic must be routed to eu-west for GDPR; we’ll send a short note on the % split.

On escalation: we need a concrete fallback plan if the dedicated pool hits saturation during a promo (e.g., route to cheaper smaller model with graceful quality signal). Can Marcus include a short decision tree?

I’ll confirm the procurement contact (legal/procurement) tomorrow.

Tom
Tom Jenkins
Head of Engineering, Iron Retail
Tom.Jenkins@ironretail.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@ironretail.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call briefing: retail growth asks & escalation lanes

Tom — thanks, noted. I’m dropping an internal SOW skeleton to get alignment on scope: baseline Dedicated capacity for recommendations, canary rollout across 3 stores, performance SLOs (p95 < 120ms), KV cache retention strategy, and fallback routing to quantized model variant.

I attached SOW-redwood-draft.docx to this message (stub). A few open points I’ll call out for our internal review before sending to you:
- Exact throughput sizing (we’ll baseline from your demo logs once you send them).
- Can we confirm whether sessionization is server-side or client tokenized? This affects cache strategy.
- Legal: Laura — can you confirm redlines we typically ask for around audit log retention windows?

Plan: internal quick read on Mon (early) and then send to Tom during the Mon 8/16 procurement sync.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
Rishi.Malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@ironretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@ironretail.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 07:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call briefing: retail growth asks & escalation lanes

Thanks all — we confirmed internal items:
- Procurement contact: procurement@ironretail.com (I’ll intro after we have the SOW + security pack).
- EU split: ~18% of traffic; will need eu-hosting for that portion.
- Pilot stores: we’re starting with three high-traffic coastal stores (names in the doc I’ll send separately).

Tom asked that any escalation playbook include a clear buyer-facing communication template (we don’t want customers to see degraded recommendations as an outage). Marcus, can you include a short customer message as part of the playbook?

We’ll be ready for the procurement call today at 11am PT if you want to walk through the SOW.

Hannah
Hannah Lowe
Director, Product Ops | Iron Retail
Hannah.Lowe@ironretail.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@ironretail.com>, Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@ironretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call briefing: retail growth asks & escalation lanes

Appreciate the quick responses — confirming next steps after the 11am sync: 

1) Olga: upload SOC2-summary-IR.pdf and network-topology-stub.png to the shared Drive and send link (done).
2) Rishi: finalize SOW-redwood-draft.docx to include throughput placeholder and fallback decision tree; send to procurement@ironretail.com by EOD Mon (2026-08-16).
3) Laura: prepare standard audit-log retention clause and quick redline template for legal review (target Tue 2026-08-17).
4) Marcus: produce a 1-page escalation playbook with buyer-facing customer message and decision tree (target Wed 2026-08-18).
5) Tom/Hannah: intro to procurement@ironretail.com and confirmation of pilot store list (target Tue 2026-08-17).

I’ll follow up with a concise one-pager that maps outcomes -> SLOs -> procurement asks by EOD. Thanks everyone — looking forward to moving this to pilot.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
